information: All validation numbers are local (fold evaluation periods). RMSLE is computed in log1p space after adding the baseline back.

trees.strict_prediction: rounds = mean best round of the other main folds
trees.final: 1.1 x mean best round of Fold 3 and Fold 4, seeds 2026 and 2027

neural.strict_prediction: fixed schedule, SWA weights (never selected on the fold)
neural.final: full schedule with SWA, seeds 2026 and 2027

protocol.gradient_norm: neural nets: mean L2 norm of the parameter gradient per epoch (before clipping at 5). trees: for an L2 objective the per-row gradient norm equals sqrt(train mse), which is what train_curve holds.

wall_clock.note: CPU and GPU streams ran in parallel, so the per-model seconds add up to more than the wall clock

alarm_diagnosis.first_run: TabM/MDN/ST-Graph with station embedding, dropout 0.1, weight decay 1e-5, lr 2e-3: best epoch 1-5 on Fold 4, then validation RMSLE rose while the training loss kept falling.
alarm_diagnosis.cause: Not a baseline mismatch between train and evaluation rows (both come from the same panel function and the same mu_eq definition). The residual r_eq contains the seasonal drift between origin and target; a flexible model fits that drift for the training months per station, and the evaluation months of Folds 1-3 (and partly 4) were never seen one year earlier. On Fold_Hot26, whose season is present in training, the alarm disappears for ST-Graph (best epoch 13-14) and tree rounds are in the hundreds.
alarm_diagnosis.fix: Station embedding removed, dropout 0.3, weight decay 3e-2, peak lr 6e-4, Huber loss (delta 0.4); all three nets retrained on every fold. The first-run logs are kept under first_run_before_fix.
alarm_diagnosis.result: The alarm persists on the folds whose target season is unseen (see early_stop_alarms). The strict predictions therefore use the fixed schedule with SWA, and the blend weight of each model is decided by its strict out-of-fold error.
